links.outcome: Readability of LLM nutrition guidance for orthodontic patients (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: BOS and AAO sources were more readable than the LLMs. ChatGPT 4.0 was the most readable LLM but was still difficult for readers.
links.quote: The readability of the responses from LLMs was difficult.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability (DISCERN), and readability of general commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Copilot, Gemini) on orthodontic nutritional guidelines compared to professional society standards, without testing a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
